Hi all,

Quick note from the infra side to make the session productive:
- Please include your network/security engineer (the person who owns firewall rules and proxy config). We will ask for a sample edge NAT/egress policy.
- If you have a pre-existing air-gap procedure (how you move artifacts into the isolated network), please share before the call. That will save 15–20 minutes.
- We'll demo the recommended artifact signing and verification flow, plus our suggested periodic update mechanism for offline clusters.

Two short questions ahead of the meeting:
1) Do you use an on-prem KMS/HSM or do you expect us to integrate with a cloud KMS via a transit gateway?
2) For storage, are you planning to expose an NFS mount to the cluster or use local node disks?

If you can drop answers in an email thread (or in the Google Drive folder) by EOD Tue Mar 2, we can incorporate into the slide deck.

Thanks,
Rishi
